rubric.hardPass: Delivered response satisfies required behaviors without unsupported claims. Appropriate explicit unknown-detail boundaries can pass. Generic clarification of an already clear question fails required responsiveness; blocked delivery is a failed interview answer, separately tracked as safety containment.

qualityRating.2: Good with a minor wording or scope issue.
qualityRating.3: Natural or appropriate boundary, accurate, concise and fully responsive.

rubric.uncertainty: Ambiguous implications are noted rather than automatically labeled false. Explicit frequency, perspective, chronology or support violations are hard failures.
